thread:
mike_r: Kicking off orion-3b-int4 staging rollout. Need an audit slab for quality + quant smoke — target ~900 examples (mix of longform, dialog, code). Want to catch hallucination regressions and tokenization edgecases. Who can own carve + label?
eva: I can assemble a slab. Plan: 650 NL (long/short mix), 150 multi-turn dialogs, 100 code snippets. Will run fuzzy dedupe at 0.78 and a second pass with n-gram overlap <0.6.
jorge: For code, include both single-file snippets and REPL-style multi-line. Add language tags (py/js/sql) so we can segment by language during eval.
liz: Labeling ops: we can run a 72h microburst with 6 labelers. Need clear rubric + edge-case examples. Also ask: should we add a "confidence" slider (0-100) in the UI? Might help triage.
sanjay: Infra ready. Note: int4 batch kernels currently favor short sequences; include a 10% bucket of very long (>1024) context to stress 95p latency. We'll enable fallback to fp16 if tail latency >1.2s.
label-bot: label-bot: created curation_job_orion_audit_1794456789, est throughput 500/hr.
mike_r: Good. Eva: please seed the slab with ~120 historical hallucination cases (from the hallu-bucket) so we can compute recall.
eva: Adding those. Candidate manifest will include provenance columns and a field for "seed_source". Uploading to s3://redwood-internal/curation/orion_audit_1794456789/candidates_v1.csv.
nana: (typo) ana: Reviewing label rubric now. Suggest adding fields: factuality: {true,false,partial}, error_scope: {entity,temporal,logical,source}, reproducibility steps. Also add a separate binary for "requires-RAG" to flag retrieval cases.
mike_r: Nice. Jorge: can you add the language tags and a short prompt variant that asks the model to "cite sources" to surface attribution failures?
jorge: Will do. Ill include both "cite" and "no-cite" variants for 200 samples.
liz: Draft label schema and sample examples: 
```text
- factuality: true|false|partial
- error_scope: entity|temporal|logical|source|other
- severity: low|med|high
- requires_RAG: yes|no
- notes: free text
- confidence: 0-100
```
label-bot: label-bot: first tranche (250) assigned to team A. ETA ~5h.
sanjay: Perf note on staging: int4 throughput +2.0x, 95p latency on longctx +15%. Sampling variance up on small-temperature settings. Logging off for correlation.
nana: ana: Also propose an "explain-step" prompt to make the model produce chain-of-thought briefly (for internal eval only). Might help detect fabrications.
mike_r: Good add. After labels are ~70% done, run the eval harness (faithfulness + hallucination recall/precision) and generate a diff vs baseline orion-v1-fp16. Store results in /tmp/orion_audit_179445 and paste link. We'll triage model-level regressions and surface top-20 failure cases.
label-bot: label-bot: progress update: 1/3 complete, next ETA 6h.
liz: Uploading final instruction doc + examples to drive link: s3://redwood-internal/curation/orion_audit_1794456789/instructions_v1.md
mike_r: Thanks everyone. Sync back when labels hit 60% and we have initial eval. :thumbsup:
